__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You encounter some rapids as you enter this tunnel cut out of
the mountains by the river.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A long tunnel

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: The tunnel branches off north.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A long tunnel

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: The tunnel branches off south.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A long tunnel

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: The tunnel branches off to the south.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A long tunnel

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are floating on a jet-black underground lake fed by dripping
water and lime from above. The tunnel continues to the east and the river
leads back west. To the north is a roughly-hewn hallway. There is also
a tunnel south.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: An underground lake

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: The tunnel rises sharply to the east.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A long narrow tunnel

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The tunnel continues east and west. To the east the tunnel dives
down into a bright light.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A wide tunnel

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand at the edge of a large pile of rubble created from the last
rockslide.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You can easily slide down the rocks without getting hurt.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5008 to 5009

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Cave-in

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are at the bottom of a large pile of rubble. A tunnel branches
off to the north and east.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: At the foot of the rubble

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in the middle of a large and beautiful cave. A path leads
deeper into the darkness.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You look down into the cave. Bones are strewn about everywhere.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5010 to 5011

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Cave entrance

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This cavern overwhelms you. The walls and ceiling seem miles away.
Bones of previous adventurers lie strewn on the cavern floor.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Giant cave

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: The tunnel turns to the south and west.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Narrow bend

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: You are standing in a large cave. Many furs are spread out on the floor.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Large cave

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: The walls here are extremely damp, as well as the floor.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You hear drops of water.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5014 to 5015

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Damp hallway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: You are wading in a knee deep pool of lime-water.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Underground pool

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The walls of the tunnel are extremely damp here. You hear the faint
sound of running water to the south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You hear drops of water.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5016 to 5015

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Damp hallway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This crawlway is just big enough for a human to crawl through or a
halfling to walk through.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You smell the fragrant odor of fungus.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5017 to 5019

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Narrow crawlway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have entered a very large cavern. The rock formations would amaze
almost any dwarf.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Large cavern

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
As you walk through the fungus patch, you are shot at by many millions of
spores. You can hardly breathe.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The fragrant smell of fungus spores continues to the east
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5019 to 5020

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Fungus patch

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
As you walk along the path, millions of spores are shot at you. You can
hardly breathe.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A giant mushroom temple stands to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5020 to 5021

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The fragrant smell of spores continues to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5020 to 5019

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Fungus path

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You find yourself standing inside of a giant mushroom. The inside
is decorated in the fashion of a temple.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Fungus temple

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: You follow a path sloping down from the fungus temple.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Sloping passage

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: You are on a path that gently slopes up from the underground pool.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You hear sounds of trickling water.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5023 to 5005

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Sloping passage

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around you.
You feel lost.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Sands of Sorrow

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This small group of desert nomads has stopped for the day to rest
and refresh themselves beside this beautiful oasis. Three tents and some
camels make up the party. From within two of the tents you hear muffled
voices, obviously surprised at your visit.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see ill-tempered camels.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5056 to 5058

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see inside one of the tents a huddled mass of people, probably slaves.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5056 to 5057

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Sand as far as the eye can see.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5056 to 5025

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A nomad camp

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This is a small and simple tent with few possessions in sight. Lying
here and there are young-looking men and women, possibly slaves to the
leader of this band.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Waving in the heat over the sand you see a HUGE pyramid.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5057 to 8700

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the center of the nomad camp.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5057 to 5056

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Inside a small tent

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Here stand about ten camels, all hitched to some stakes plugged into
the ground. To the east you see a small tent while to the north you see a
larger, fancier tent.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
This tent seems to be the temporary abode of the nomad leader. You make a
mental note to visit it before you leave.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5058 to 5060

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: In this tent there are very large men, all carrying weapons.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5058 to 5059

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the center of the nomad camp.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5058 to 5056

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Beside the camels

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This tent has a few furnishings, but mainly it holds the band's
protectors. They all stare at you coldly as you enter.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Outside you see some peaceful camels.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5059 to 5058

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The warrior's tent.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This tent is as lavishly decorated on the inside as it is on the
outside. A fancy carpet lies on the sand and numerous baskets line the
walls.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see some peaceful camels.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5060 to 5058

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The main tent

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This is where the leader of this band of nomads resides. He is
definitely rich as you inspect the tapestries, baskets, and a few
paintings as well.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the entrance to this tent.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5061 to 5060

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The main tent

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around
you.  But this patch of desert looks different...the sand glows.  You see a
futuristic city to the south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a futuristic city.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5062 to 8001

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Sand as far as the eye can see.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5062 to 5029

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Strange Glowing Sand

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Being very careful not to lose your balance, you look around and
find that this canyon is about a half a kilometer deep. To the west is
a dark cave leading under the desert sands.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Sand as far as the eye can see.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5063 to 5031

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a dark cave.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5063 to 5064

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The wind-swept ledge

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The air in here is MUCH cooler than outside. From the west you hear
strange sounds, but can see nothing. The cave slopes down into the
darkness.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Outside is lighter and very windy.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5064 to 5063

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The cave mouth

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have stumbled upon the home of something. From the treasure
haphazardly strewn about and the rotting carcasses, you would guess that
this is a dragon's lair. As to what type, you can't really say. The cave
narrows out into a tunnel to the west.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The mysterious lair.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This tunnel seems to go on forever into the darkness. You carefully
feel your way along the walls.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A wide tunnel

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The tunnel becomes very narrow and you fight to squeeze your way through.
The floor seems to level off a little.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A narrower tunnel

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This part of the tunnel is the hardest to move through as the walls
move in to meet you.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A narrow crack

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
It is dark and damp and bats hang from the ceiling. A narrow crack is
in the east wall. The floor now slopes upwards.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A small cavern.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
From within this shaft you can see a narrow hole in the roof just
large enough for one person. Back south is the cavern.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A small shaft
